hero: ICRA’s October activity gauge reached a three-year high, helped by a low base. New government buying rules favour Indian hardware design and chipmaking, while the Commerce Ministry seeks a fix for Scotch import duties. The Supreme Court ruled on IDBI Bank’s constitutional status, and climate talks stalled over fossil fuels. A KPMG–CII report measures AI agent use, and Shadowfax has a deal to expand into same-day delivery.

cards.mechanism: Improvement across more than half the indicators suggests the pickup extended beyond a few series, although the low base helped lift the headline rate.
cards.watch: Watch whether the next reading shows improvement across a similar share of indicators.

cards.mechanism: The classification determines which duty applies, so a customs resolution could affect both import costs and the time shipments spend awaiting clearance.
cards.watch: Look for written customs guidance or confirmation that the pending consignments have been released.

claims.statement: Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agarwal has urged the DRI to release pending consignments.
evidence: Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agarwal said India remains committed to its tariff obligations and has urged the DRI to release pending consignments.

cards.mechanism: An agreement on who finances the transition could give India and other developing countries more room to accept common targets.
cards.watch: Watch whether the next negotiating text pairs fossil-fuel language with a concrete financing commitment.

evidence: The UN climate summit in Antalya, Türkiye, ended without consensus, with countries unable to agree on reaffirming the commitment to transition away from fossil fuels.

claims.statement: India challenged the push for new targets without addressing historical use of the carbon budget and who would pay for the transition.
evidence: India challenged the attempt to set new global targets without addressing who had used up the carbon budget and who must pay for the transition.

catalyst_review: No material India-specific November 26 catalyst is supported. The Nagpur Constitution Day rally has a date but no stated policy decision. The US Thanksgiving exchange closure changes overseas trading hours. The Yamuna Expressway speed change and Wednesday bail hearing point to November 25 from November 24 reporting. The December vehicle price changes, bank strike threat, gas auction and possible aircraft delivery fall later. JioStar provides only a week-level schedule for cuts.
